(import (scheme base)
        (scheme cxr)
        (scheme write)
        (srfi 1)) ; for append-map
 
;; Breadth-first search implementation
(define (bfs start goal? successors)
  (let loop ((frontier (list (list start)))
             (explored '()))
    (if (null? frontier)
      #f
      (let* ((path (car frontier))
             (node (last-pair path)))
        (if (goal? node)
          path
          (loop (append (map (lambda (successor)
                               (cons successor path))
                             (successors node))
                        (cdr frontier))
                (cons node explored)))))))

         (start 'a)
